behavior_matrix.happy: Validate a fixture-supported read capability, create account/credential anchor, establish a quiet baseline, and atomically publish complete normalized snapshots. behavior_matrix.failure: Source timeout, authorization loss, invalid quantity/unit or inconsistent page sequence retains the prior snapshot marked stale/unavailable. Empty or partial responses never zero stock or tombstone unseen lots. A missing date remains unknown; best-before and expiry are not conflated.
behavior_matrix.concurrency: Serialize publication per account with a generation fence; a slower scan cannot overwrite a newer committed scan. If the source lacks a consistent snapshot/version mechanism, label the aggregate partial rather than claim a coherent total. Account revocation wins over in-flight publication and reads.
behavior_matrix.idempotence: Use account plus source object plus source revision/content digest for envelope keys. Commit snapshot generations and pending event identities together; retry submission before advancing its acceptance checkpoint. Broker reminder keys include item, reminder kind and source revision to suppress repeats.
behavior_matrix.rollback: Disable the connector/module and revoke the account through the existing retirement contract. Keep historical evidence under an explicit retention rule while prohibiting fresh-current claims or new reminders. No source data was mutated, so no external compensating write is required.

behavior_matrix.happy: Lock corrected source, identify recorded direct derivatives, create holds and suppress projections atomically. Review commits a newly supported successor or retirement, with a terminal result.

behavior_matrix.expiry: Ordinary TTL cleanup preserves readable derived artifacts as specified. Explicit correction followed by cleanup preserves artifact-side holds and content-free correction pointers.
behavior_matrix.failure: Malformed evidence, unknown attribution or review failure keeps an honest unresolved hold. Correction/hold/projection failure rolls back with failed status. Specify a bounded direct-dependent cap and transaction timeout; over-cap returns impact_too_large before mutation, never partial success.
behavior_matrix.concurrency: Correction and evidence-linked artifact commits lock the source in the same documented order. Consolidation rechecks correction under its existing claim fence. Review uses CAS on artifact/review revision; later correction or owner assertion invalidates stale model output. Guard late catalog write-behind/backfills against resurrecting held artifacts.
behavior_matrix.idempotence: One review item per artifact revision/correction identity. Retried correction returns the same impact result; review retry cannot duplicate successors. Resolving one cause cannot clear another outstanding correction hold.
behavior_matrix.rollback: Disable automated review while retaining holds and owner inspection. Do not roll back readers to versions that ignore persisted holds, and do not reactivate artifacts merely because the worker is disabled.

behavior_matrix.happy: Record a last-known location and source; locate answers as of that statement. Borrow records a named active custody episode. Owner-reported return cites that episode and closes it. Retire preserves history and removes the item from active-possession answers.
behavior_matrix.failure: Ambiguous item identity prompts selection without a write. Missing source or unknown location stays unknown. Unavailable linked Finance evidence yields an unavailable evidence door while retaining the owner statement; it does not fabricate purchase or ownership certainty.
behavior_matrix.concurrency: Lock the existing item and compare expected profile revision. Two competing moves/returns cannot both become the next accepted revision; reject the stale write and show the intervening transition. Historical reports carry event time separately from recorded time and cannot silently replace a later current projection.
behavior_matrix.idempotence: An operation identity is stored with the transition. Retrying identical content returns the same event/receipt; same identity with different content is refused. Replay never opens a second loan or closes a different loan.
behavior_matrix.rollback: Correction appends a superseding transition and recomputes the projection; it never asserts the physical action was undone. Profile opt-out/export must preserve history or require explicit owner deletion, with collection-level deletion included in that boundary.
behavior_matrix.uncertainty: Location always says last reported with a date. Borrower identity and physical location are separate fields. Unresolved contradictory observations produce a conflict rather than invented certainty; absence of an observation does not mean absent possession.

findings.title: Conversation owner lookup failure can clear a draft on a predictably rejected endpoint
findings.detail: Only a 404 lookup error receives a terminal branch. On an initial non-404 error, `butlerName` becomes null, the turn hook receives `WIDGET_BUTLER`, the composer is disabled only while loading, and an existing route ID makes `sendText` call `sendMessage(WIDGET_BUTLER, activeConversationId, ...)` after `handleSend` has already cleared the input. The backend verifies the conversation belongs to the path butler and rejects the mismatch before unarchive or persistence, so this is not a durable cross-butler misroute; the user still loses the visible draft and sees an opaque send error instead of the actual owner-resolution outage.

moves.title: Fail closed while an existing conversation's owner is unresolved
moves.why: Specialist ownership must resolve before an existing conversation can send. The backend already rejects a mismatched owner before persistence; the client should preserve the draft, name the lookup outage, and retry that lookup instead of clearing input and making a predictably rejected request.
moves.outcome: For the initial load of `/chat/:conversationId`, unresolved or failed owner resolution cannot instantiate a send-capable turn against a fallback butler. The thread pane shows a named retryable resolution error, preserves unsent text in component state, and enables history and mutation only after the authoritative owner resolves. A background lookup refetch after an owner has already been established does not disable Stop or discard the bound owner. Bare `/chat` continues to start a Switchboard conversation.

behavior_matrix.happy: Record a last-known location and source; locate answers as of that statement. Borrow records a named active custody episode. Owner-reported return cites that episode and closes it. Retire preserves history and removes the item from active-possession answers.
behavior_matrix.failure: Ambiguous item identity prompts selection without a write. Missing source or unknown location stays unknown. Unavailable linked Finance evidence yields an unavailable evidence door while retaining the owner statement; it does not fabricate purchase or ownership certainty.
behavior_matrix.concurrency: Lock the existing item and compare expected profile revision. Two competing moves/returns cannot both become the next accepted revision; reject the stale write and show the intervening transition. Historical reports carry event time separately from recorded time and cannot silently replace a later current projection. Every generic whole-JSON update to an opted-in item, even an unrelated key, must share the same row-lock/CAS protocol; namespace write blocking alone cannot protect against stale whole-document replacement.
behavior_matrix.idempotence: An operation identity is stored with the transition. Retrying identical content returns the same event/receipt; same identity with different content is refused. Replay never opens a second loan or closes a different loan.
behavior_matrix.rollback: Correction appends a superseding transition and recomputes the projection; it never asserts the physical action was undone. Profile opt-out/export must preserve history or require explicit owner deletion, with collection-level deletion included in that boundary.
behavior_matrix.uncertainty: Location always says last reported with a date. Borrower identity and physical location are separate fields. Unresolved contradictory observations produce a conflict rather than invented certainty; absence of an observation does not mean absent possession.

behavior_matrix.happy: Owner supplies checklist r1 with three clauses, selects sources, and confirms proposed matches. All three covered at pinned versions produces one preparation receipt and index. The conversation states complete against your checklist r1.
behavior_matrix.failure: Missing/ambiguous clauses remain explicit; extraction failure, inaccessible source, or unresolved cross-domain authorization produces unavailable/needs_review and blocks completeness. A declined clause is excluded only by an owner-confirmed checklist revision, never by silent model waiver.
behavior_matrix.concurrency: Checklist edit and prepare race under a revision comparison: only the exact evaluated revision may settle. Stale reviews fail with a recoverable changed-checklist response.
behavior_matrix.idempotence: Request identity plus packet revision yields one preparation receipt. Transport retries return it rather than creating tasks or duplicate receipts.
behavior_matrix.rollback: Archive/reopen a packet without altering source records. Checklist or evidence revision changes require renewed review of affected matches; old receipts remain historical and are labeled superseded. Withdrawal cannot erase the prior receipt or mark an external application cancelled.
behavior_matrix.completion_boundary: Preparing an index never completes a submission deadline or a promise to send documents. Only a preparation-specific commitment may close against this receipt; any external outcome requires separately supplied evidence and authority.
behavior_matrix.version_authority: Each accepted source requires an authoritative immutable version ID, versioned reference or authorized content hash. Filename, fetched_at, mutable URL/blob locator or row ID alone is not a version proof. Unverifiable versions are version_unverifiable/unavailable and cannot produce current completeness.
behavior_matrix.evidence_race: Prepare fences checklist revision AND accepted evidence versions/read authority. If evidence changes or authority is revoked between evaluation and commit, refuse current completeness; retain old receipts as historical, never silently promote them.

bounded_contract_options.question: What is the first registry slice?

bounded_contract_options.alternative: Ship open_list first as historical S5 proposed, but it cannot claim commitment closure or answer what remains unresolved.
bounded_contract_options.reason: Two question types establish the desired owner payoff without inventing five archetype playbooks.

bounded_contract_options.question: What counts as a satisfied requirement?
bounded_contract_options.recommended: Separate contributor receipt state from domain conclusion. Every required question has pending/answered/declined/unmeasurable/unclaimed receipt state and an independently typed supported/contradicted/unknown assessment with evidence validity.
bounded_contract_options.alternative: Reuse S2 satisfied as the sole state only if renamed to answered everywhere and keep a separate readiness predicate; never let evidence count mean task complete.
bounded_contract_options.denominator: Pin all required role/question keys at case creation, including unclaimed roles. Optional roles stay visibly separate. Changes to requirements create a new case contract revision.

bounded_contract_options.question: How is a terminal owner outcome recorded?
bounded_contract_options.recommended: Preserve RFC state=closed with a typed, immutable closure receipt: fulfilled, owner_closed_with_unresolved, owner_cancelled, or lapsed_unverified, each carrying the question vector and authority that justified it. Initial new owner-declared cases are owner-close-only.
bounded_contract_options.alternative: Ship read-only assessment first and continue displaying existing outcome strings as legacy unverified closure; defer all new closure writes.
bounded_contract_options.constraint: fulfilled requires evidence for each required result and no unresolved owner question. Explicit owner acknowledgement can close with unresolved items, but cannot relabel those items fulfilled. Approval accepted, tool invoked and notification delivered are not execution-result proofs.

behavior_matrix.happy: Two required contributors report fresh, nonconflicting support for two explicit questions; read says two questions answered, lists outstanding owner decision separately. Owner explicitly closes only after the selected closure predicate and authority check pass.
behavior_matrix.missing_or_blind: Unclaimed, pending, declined, stale and unmeasurable each remain visible. Optional absence does not block; required decline cannot disappear from the denominator. Repair links disclose no provider error content.
behavior_matrix.partial_or_failed_read: No-source, unavailable and a successful empty set are distinct. A failed aggregate or truncated evidence list cannot yield all handled. Existing safe data may show its prior snapshot with an explicit stale qualifier.
behavior_matrix.concurrent_report_close: All admitted question mutations and close take a common case-row serialization boundary. Close verifies expected case revision and freezes its vector atomically. Changed evidence returns conflict with latest safe projection; evidence arriving after close is late evidence and never rewrites the terminal proof or reopens the case.
behavior_matrix.concurrent_horizon_change: Owner changes horizon or requirements by a revisioned operation; old answers stay historical and old contributions are reevaluated against the new interval rather than blindly retained as satisfied. No dispatch replay follows a read.
behavior_matrix.evidence_expiry: Fresh at snapshot time is not fresh forever. valid_until is checked again when closing; expiry does not silently rewrite source certainty. Existing supported receipt may now project stale/unknown.
behavior_matrix.idempotence: Contribution identity includes request/source revision so a revised observation does not collide with the existing immutable kind/ref dedup tuple. Same idempotency key plus same semantic payload returns its receipt; same key plus different payload conflicts. Closure retry returns the original closure receipt without reexecuting any domain action.
behavior_matrix.contradiction: Keep both attributable contradictory reports and show conflict; do not let last arrival win semantically. Resolution requires an authoritative new domain result or explicit owner disposition.
behavior_matrix.lapse: Existing deterministic lapse remains visible as unverified lapse. New owner-declared cases require the S3 exemption and never auto-close because evidence went quiet. Deadline reached means question overdue, not fulfilled.
behavior_matrix.rollback: Disable new registry types/read routing while retaining evidence, revision and closure receipts. Do not downgrade away owner-close-only protection while protected cases remain. Schema rollback requires an explicit compatibility plan, not destructive receipt deletion.
behavior_matrix.execution_boundary: Situation read, declaration, contributor response, owner acknowledgement and close do not send, purchase, schedule, remediate, retry an external action or cancel a prepared action. Each domain execution keeps its separate approval and result lifecycle.

design.owner_flow: The answer leads with the actual outcome: one question remains unresolved, or all required evidence is current. Show the missing contributor/question and one safe door next. Closure copy says fulfilled, cancelled or closed with unresolved items exactly as recorded; keyboard and screen-reader surfaces consume the same status fields. No chart or completion percentage can turn an unclaimed role into calm.

design.why: Preserve completed work and explain why it stopped without paying twice or repeating an outward act. Deterministic daemon admission follows vision Rule 4 and architecture Core Loop Log; Switchboard retains routing ownership.

authority.current: Preservation and an owner-visible stopped result only. No new auto-retry, guardrail continuation, deadline extension, tier increase, or budget activation authorized by this design.
authority.owner_decisions: Use bu-h40h2b.9 existing blocked scope/precedence/degrade authority decision. A future continuation policy needs its own exact opt-in on eligible read-only intent classes, finite additional spend/tool/deadline limits, and unknown-result behavior. Existing no-resume semantics remain until a paired spec explicitly changes them.
authority.no_inference: Neither a successful provider process, successful source refresh, completed predecessor action, preserved partial, policy-read recovery nor restoration after restart authorizes a successor.
authority.stop: Owner Stop/cancel, shutdown cancellation, permission denial, private-locality refusal, budget exhaustion and elapsed absolute deadline are terminal for the logical request under current authority.

minimal_contract: Both proposed doors submit a typed handoff request to one deterministic decision seam; they do not dispatch directly. Current mode is evidence-only; no shadow provider/tool calls.

Require finalized predecessor, stable logical root, preserved partial reference and tool-effect coverage receipt from bu-2jtfw.5 before considering eligibility. Missing or failed preservation records unavailable evidence and no successor.

Escalation requested is a distinct predecessor disposition. Provider success, predecessor disposition, successor admission and final user outcome are separate axes; never mark the logical request completed merely because the request_escalation tool returned.

If separately authorized later: at most ONE successor SESSION per logical root across escalation and continuation, including multiple source handlers or butlers. A UNIQUE(root,from_session) key alone is insufficient. No recursive tier hopping.

Use existing verified routing at the same deterministic admission seam, rerunning current permissions/locality/breaker/quota/spend rules/fleet ceiling/approval constraints. Inherit immutable purpose and owner intent; no arbitrary model name or new authority from findings.

Continuation input is a bounded, explicitly untrusted partial-evidence bundle plus unsatisfied task objective. It carries no executable replay list and cannot widen tool authority. New session starts with a narrowly restricted capability projection; do not resume a provider conversation whose pending tools might re-execute.

Keep absolute deadline and cumulative request budget; a new session ID does not reset them. Extra capacity requires separately recorded owner authority. Unknown priced usage cannot count as zero for a hard cap.

idempotency_and_crash: One transaction locks the logical root, rechecks terminal/cancel/policy versions, and reserves stable successor session identity with root uniqueness. Duplicate requests return that stored disposition.

Execution claims use CAS plus fencing token. Stop increments durable cancel generation under the same coordination boundary; admission verifies generation immediately before provider invocation and cancels an already registered active successor through existing cancellation machinery.
Restart before proven invocation may recover the same reserved session only with durable evidence that invocation never began. A lease expiry alone is insufficient.

Crash after marking dispatching, or loss between invocation and acknowledgement, yields unknown and requires reconciliation of that same stable identity. Never allocate another successor or replay merely because a lease expired.
If adapter cannot prove dispatch identity/outcome, hold. This deliberately chooses at-most-once dispatch with possible manual recovery, not an unsupported exactly-once provider claim.
Readmission rejects any changed/revoked authority and preserves reason; no queued item is silently activated when an unavailable source becomes healthy.
action_replay_safety: Minimal future eligible class is provably read-only at server tool projection and effect capture boundaries. A session label such as classification, REVERSIBLE, or source success does not prove its tools were read-only.

Any confirmed outward action, pending approval, submitted action with unknown result, incomplete capture, or arbitrary side-effect-capable tool surface leaves the handoff held/refused. Do not repeat successful actions.
Reversible does not mean idempotent. Compensation is a separate domain-owned, authorized action; it is never automatic rollback of a prior tool.
External outcome reconciliation uses existing domain-owned receipts through MCP/Switchboard; no cross-schema inspection or generic replay endpoint.
